title: feat(spec,runtime): an organization-scoped manage_connector_connections capability gates the connector connection door (ADR-0143 D5)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoHYfNHsvqsysdsGt6GdpVVZ)_

Fixes #28327

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: updated here — content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx names the connect door's capability; no skill under skills/** teaches that door's gate

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新增组织级能力 `manage_connector_connections`,连接器 OAuth2 连接的四个入口(查看状态、发起连接、回调、撤销)改为只认这个能力,不再认平台级的 `manage_metadata`。
- 为什么改:给连接器绑定供应商账号是"组织"的事(ADR-0143 Q1 = A),却用平台级元数据权限把关;S4 控制台连接流程上线前要先把权限放对。
- 风险与回滚:平台管理员(`admin_full_access`)默认持有,行为不变;组织管理员默认不持有,需显式授予(不放宽任何人)。该入口今早才合并、尚未发版,没有已发布的调用方失去权限。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`(`refuseUngrantedConnectorConnectionAccess`)、`packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts`(新条目)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-connector-connection-door.test.ts`(两个方向的钉子)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/automation-connector-connection-door.test.ts`,预期 22 个测试全绿,其中"`manage_metadata` alone no longer admits"与"organization administrator on the shipped grant is refused"各 4 条。
- 需要你做的:组织管理员是否应默认持有该能力(放宽,属人工地板),请裁决;代码本身无需你操作,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec`**: `PLATFORM_CAPABILITIES` gains `manage_connector_connections` (label "Manage Connector Connections", `scope: 'org'`), the capability ADR-0143 D5 delegates to the server slice. `ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES` (the eval fixture `admin_full_access` is built from) carries it; no other shipped set does.
- **`@objectstack/runtime`**: the connection door's gate (`refuseUngrantedConnectorConnectionAccess`) asks `CONNECTOR_CONNECTION_CAPABILITY` = `manage_connector_connections` for all four members: `GET` / `POST` / `DELETE /automation/connectors/:name/connection` and `GET /automation/connectors/oauth/callback`. Fail-closed, only `isSystem` bypassing, placed where it was (ahead of the service probe and the query checks). The refusal text names the new capability. The four route-ledger rows say so.
- **Setup widget (`@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/i18n`)**: the capability picker's curated label set and `capability.label.manage_connector_connections` in `useFieldTranslation` and all ten locale packs (the spec-parity and locale-parity pins require both).
- **Docs**: `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx` named `manage_metadata` for the connect calls; it now names the new capability and who holds it.
- **Changeset** `28327-manage-connector-connections.md` (minor on the four moved packages).

Untouched, by the order's serial note: no provider and no `connector-credential-source.ts` edit (#26702 S2 owns those). The credential door (`/connectors/credential-refs`) and its Setup nav entry keep `manage_metadata`: they act on environment-level credentials, not on an organization's connection.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-connector-connection-door.test.ts`: the refusal pins name the new capability; new pins, each over all four members:
  - `manage_metadata` alone, and the whole platform-only set (`manage_metadata`, `studio.access`, `setup.access`, `manage_users`, `manage_platform_settings`) without the new capability → 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, no service member called.
  - the organization administrator's shipped grant (`manage_org_users`, `setup.access`, `setup.write`, `manage_mailboxes`) → 403, no member called; the same grant plus `manage_connector_connections` → 200 and the member called once with the caller's organization.
  - `isSystem` passes without the capability; an absent capability list is refused.
  - the gate's constant is the spec-declared, `org`-scoped capability.
- `packages/spec/src/identity/platform-admin-capabilities.test.ts`: `ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES` carries it and it is declared `org`.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security`: `default-permission-sets.test.ts` pins `admin_full_access` as its only shipped holder; the platform-administrator envelopes in four golden/equivalence suites gain it (the `TENANT_ADMIN` envelopes stay without it).

## Acceptance notes

- **Default grant to organization administrators is NOT made.** ADR-0143 says Console Connect / Reconnect is organization-level, and the order's security floor says this card tightens and widens no one. Adding the capability to `organization_admin` / `organization_admin_no_bypass` would let every organization owner or admin connect a vendor account where today they cannot: a widening of an access-control boundary, which is a human floor in this lane. Until ruled, an organization administrator connects only after an explicit grant. Ablation 3 below shows the pin that holds this.
- **The `manage_metadata` → `manage_connector_connections` move narrows the door relative to `main`** for a set that grants `manage_metadata` without `admin_full_access`. The door landed with #28317 (2026-10-31 08:28Z) and its changeset `26702-connector-oauth2-connections.md` is still pending in `.changeset/`, so no published version served it: no released caller loses access, and the `Clause-②` arm is declared on the protocol change (a new accepted capability name).
- The door test transcribes the organization administrator's grant rather than importing it (runtime does not depend on plugin-security); the seeded-set side is pinned in plugin-security.

## Verification

Implementation commit `7354e08f4` on base `origin/main` `3ba520691`; head `3979c8fbb` merges `origin/main` `ac09e7b85` (no overlapping file). After the merge: install, rebuild of the runtime closure, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` exit 0 (14 artifacts up to date), and the door, spec, five plugin-security and ui parity files re-run green (22 / 403 / 92 / 68 tests).

<details><summary>Build and tests</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/runtime^...' --filter @objectstack/runtime build` → VERDICT command-exit 0.
- door test + `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-capability-gate.test.ts` → Test Files 2 passed, Tests 101 passed; spec `src/identity/platform-admin-capabilities.test.ts src/security/` → Test Files 16 passed, Tests 403 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test` → Test Files 238 passed, Tests 5125 passed / 45 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` → Test Files 491 passed, Tests 7981 passed / 19 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` → exit 0 (same lock run, VERDICT command-exit 0).
- ui, from `ui/`: `vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/CapabilityMultiSelectField packages/i18n/src/__tests__/all-locales-key-parity.test.ts packages/i18n/src/__tests__/en-zh-key-parity.test.ts` → Test Files 4 passed, Tests 68 passed.
- lint: `eslint --no-inline-config` over the touched non-ui files → exit 0; `ui/` eslint over the touched ui files → exit 0 (3 pre-existing warnings in `CapabilityMultiSelectField.tsx`, none on changed lines).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob with an empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

The subjects are imported from source by relative path (`./automation.js`, `./default-permission-sets.js`), so no dist rebuild sits between mutation and run.

1. Put `manage_metadata` back beside the new capability in the gate → door test: 4 failed / 18 passed, exactly the four "`manage_metadata` alone no longer admits the caller" cases.
2. Remove the gate (`return undefined`) → door test: 13 failed / 9 passed: every refusal pin, every `manage_metadata`-alone pin, every organization-administrator pin and the fail-closed pin.
3. Add the capability to the `organization_admin` shipped set → plugin-security: 4 failed / 28 passed: the "no other shipped set carries the connector connection capability" pin (`expected [ 'admin_full_access', …(2) ] to deeply equal [ 'admin_full_access' ]`) and the three per-posture `TENANT_ADMIN` envelope goldens.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `7354e08f4`: 113 families derived, each run with stdin closed, exit codes recorded before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: **113 derived, 111 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**.

- Three first runs exited on a missing build or shallow history and were re-run after clearing it, green: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (fetched its pinned fixture commit), `check:skill-examples` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (built `@objectstack/client` and `@objectstack/client-react`; then Test Files 169 passed / 2 skipped).
- NOT MEASURED, reason: prerequisite not met (exit 3, nothing read): `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs every package's `dist/`, i.e. a full `pnpm build`) and `pnpm check:i18n` (needs the built CLI and its extract closure). No committed translation bundle names a capability, so neither reads a file this diff changes; both run in CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`.

</details>
